title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
byline: Lukas Zbinden, Javier Gamazo, Mostafa Toloui, Sean Huver
excerpt: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face

Surgical robotics is moving quickly from teleoperation toward increasingly capable vision-language-action policies. But evaluating and training these systems remains difficult. Physical robotic platforms are expensive to operate, experiments are slow to reproduce, and failures can damage instruments or biological material. Conventional simulators provide a safer alternative, but surgical scenes are exceptionally difficult to model: deformable tissue, fine instrument interactions, specular surfaces, sutures, needles, smoke, and occlusions all matter.

World foundation models offer a different path. Instead of manually authoring every object and physical interaction, they learn visual dynamics directly from synchronized video and robot kinematics. NVIDIA's Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator demonstrated this approach by generating future surgical video from an initial scene and a sequence of robot actions. It enabled faster-than-physical evaluation and synthetic data generation across the Open-H-Embodiment ecosystem.

Today, we are introducing the next step: Cosmos-H-Dreams, a real-time, action-conditioned generative simulator for surgical robotics. Cosmos-H-Dreams distills the capabilities of Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator into a causal, few-step student model and serves it through FlashDreams, NVIDIA's accelerated streaming-inference library. Running on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the result is an interactive environment that a person or a learned policy can control in a closed loop.

1. From Surgical World Model to Interactive Simulator

Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator is an action-conditioned world foundation model built on NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B and post-trained on the Open-H-Embodiment dataset. Given a surgical context frame and a future robot trajectory, it generates video showing the likely visual consequences of those actions. This makes it useful for offline policy evaluation and synthetic data generation. A recorded or policy-generated trajectory can be sent to the model, the corresponding rollout can be generated, and the result can be inspected or scored without repeatedly executing the motion on a physical robot.

Cosmos-H-Dreams moves the model into the real-time regime. Starting from the multi-embodiment surgical priors learned by Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, we specialize the model for da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) tabletop suturing and distill it into a causal student that generates the scene autoregressively. The released model receives an initial RGB frame and a live stream of robot kinematics, then produces the next chunk of frames before continuing with the following action block.

We have also demonstrated the versatility of Cosmos-H-Dreams by collaborating with CMR Surgical and Cambridge Consultants to integrate it with the Versius surgeon controller, enabling real-time operation on the Versius platform.

2. Distilling Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator for Real Time

The key challenge is preserving useful surgical dynamics while reducing the cost of generation. Cosmos-H-Dreams uses a teacher-to-student training pipeline designed for long, autoregressive rollouts.

2.1. A Surgical Teacher

The bidirectional teacher begins from the Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator Open-H checkpoint, which uses a unified 44-dimensional action representation. For the released dVRK tabletop model, the dual-arm dVRK action content, consisting of relative end-effector translation, rotation, and gripper state, is mapped into this common representation.

The teacher is then fine-tuned on the JHU dVRK tabletop mixture, including successful demonstrations as well as failure and out-of-distribution episodes such as needle drops, missed throws, and unsuccessful knot ties. These failures are important: a simulator intended to evaluate policies must reproduce the consequences of poor actions, not only ideal demonstrations.

To improve stability during long rollouts, the training process progressively increases the teacher's temporal horizon. We start training on a 12-frame horizon and progressively increase this number until 72 frames. At each horizon bump, we initialize the warmed-up model with pretrained weights.

2.2. Causal Warmup

The teacher's denoising trajectories are first precomputed and cached. A causal student is initialized from the teacher and trained to imitate these cached trajectories. This warmup stage teaches the student to operate with causal attention and a streaming key/value cache before it begins learning from its own generated history.

2.3. Self-Forcing Distillation

Autoregressive models face a familiar problem: during training they may see clean, ground-truth context, while during deployment they must condition on their own imperfect outputs. Small errors can therefore compound over time.

Cosmos-H-Dreams addresses this mismatch with self-forcing distillation. During training, the student rolls forward using its own generated context. Distribution-matching supervision from the frozen teacher then guides those self-generated rollouts toward realistic surgical video. This prepares the student for the same conditions it will encounter during interactive inference.

The resulting model supports few-step diffusion, with as few as two denoising steps per latent frame, rather than the many-step process used by the full teacher. It combines the teacher's surgical priors with the causal structure needed for streaming.

3. FlashDreams: The Real-Time Inference Engine

Model distillation is only part of the real-time story. Cosmos-H-Dreams is served through FlashDreams, an accelerated inference library for autoregressive world and video models.

FlashDreams turns the distilled student into a low-latency streaming system through several complementary optimizations, such as streaming KV cache, CUDA Graph capturing, or model compilation.

Together, these techniques bring the distilled surgical world model fine-tune from the roughly ten-frames-per-second regime of standard Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator inference to interactive operation (~160 frames per second) on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000.

Cosmos-H-Dreams also provides the human-machine interfaces that turn generation into interaction. A browser client can send keyboard commands and receive generated frames over WebRTC. A Meta Quest client can map tracked controller motion into robot actions and display the synthesized scene through WebXR. The same model can also be connected to a learned surgical policy, with generated observations and predicted actions exchanged inside a closed loop.

4. Adapting to Your Own Data

While Cosmos-H-Dreams includes a pre-trained checkpoint for tabletop suturing, the system is designed to be extensible to your specific embodiment. To train a real-time student model for your own dataset, we provide a complete recipe for teacher fine-tuning and self-forcing distillation in our step-by-step guide.

5. What Is Next: Toward Closed-Loop Surgical Physical AI

Cosmos-H-Dreams opens a new frontier for surgical simulation: environments learned from real robot data that are responsive enough to be inhabited.

The immediate next step is to evaluate more than visual quality. A useful surgical simulator must respond correctly to actions, preserve instrument and scene structure over long rollouts, and support conclusions that transfer to the physical robot. This motivates a new family of closed-loop benchmarks: tool-tip reach and pose accuracy, gripper-cycle fidelity, idle stability, counterfactual action diversity, long-horizon drift, and agreement between simulated and real policy outcomes.

Real-time world models can also become active partners in surgical policy development. They can generate rare failures on demand, provide scalable environments for reinforcement or imitation learning, and enable rapid evaluation of new policies without tying every experiment to scarce robotic hardware.

Further ahead, real-time simulation enables a series of downstream applications such as latency-aware telesurgery, where the world model helps maintain a more stable display; or interactive surgical rehearsal, procedure planning, and intraoperative decision support. Cosmos-H-Dreams is a research and development platform, not a diagnostic system, a replacement for intraoperative imaging, or a controller for a physical surgical robot. Yet it provides a foundation for exploring these possibilities safely.

As model fidelity, temporal stability, and hardware efficiency continue to improve, real-time generative simulation can help connect surgeon education, synthetic data generation, policy training, and policy evaluation within one shared Physical AI environment.

6. Get Started Today

Explore the models, data, and runtime behind Cosmos-H-Dreams:

  • Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator: Hugging Face model and GitHub repository

  • FlashDreams: GitHub repository

sentences.en: For the released dVRK tabletop model, the dual-arm dVRK action content, consisting of relative end-effector translation, rotation, and gripper state, is mapped into this common representation.
sentences.zh: 对于已发布的 dVRK 桌面模型，双臂 dVRK 动作内容（包括相对末端执行器平移、旋转和夹具状态）被映射到此通用表示中。

blocks.html_en: The teacher is then fine-tuned on the JHU dVRK tabletop mixture, including successful demonstrations as well as failure and out-of-distribution episodes such as needle drops, missed throws, and unsuccessful knot ties. These failures are important: a simulator intended to evaluate policies must reproduce the consequences of poor actions, not only ideal demonstrations.

sentences.en: The teacher is then fine-tuned on the JHU dVRK tabletop mixture, including successful demonstrations as well as failure and out-of-distribution episodes such as needle drops, missed throws, and unsuccessful knot ties.
sentences.zh: 然后，教师在 JHU dVRK 桌面混合物上进行微调，包括成功的演示以及失败和未分配的事件，例如落针、错过投掷和不成功的打结。

sentences.en: These failures are important: a simulator intended to evaluate policies must reproduce the consequences of poor actions, not only ideal demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 这些失败很重要：旨在评估政策的模拟器必须重现不良行为的后果，而不仅仅是理想的演示。

blocks.html_en: To improve stability during long rollouts, the training process progressively increases the teacher's temporal horizon. We start training on a 12-frame horizon and progressively increase this number until 72 frames. At each horizon bump, we initialize the warmed-up model with pretrained weights.

sentences.en: To improve stability during long rollouts, the training process progressively increases the teacher's temporal horizon.
sentences.zh: 为了提高长期部署期间的稳定性，培训过程逐渐增加教师的时间视野。

sentences.en: We start training on a 12-frame horizon and progressively increase this number until 72 frames.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在 12 帧范围内进行训练，并逐渐增加这个数字直到 72 帧。

sentences.en: At each horizon bump, we initialize the warmed-up model with pretrained weights.
sentences.zh: 在每个地平线凹凸处，我们使用预训练的权重初始化预热模型。

blocks.html_en: 2.2. Causal Warmup

sentences.en: Causal Warmup
sentences.zh: 因果热身

blocks.html_en: The teacher's denoising trajectories are first precomputed and cached. A causal student is initialized from the teacher and trained to imitate these cached trajectories. This warmup stage teaches the student to operate with causal attention and a streaming key/value cache before it begins learning from its own generated history.

sentences.en: The teacher's denoising trajectories are first precomputed and cached.
sentences.zh: 首先预先计算并缓存教师的去噪轨迹。

sentences.en: A causal student is initialized from the teacher and trained to imitate these cached trajectories.
sentences.zh: 因果学生从教师处初始化并接受训练以模仿这些缓存的轨迹。

sentences.en: This warmup stage teaches the student to operate with causal attention and a streaming key/value cache before it begins learning from its own generated history.
sentences.zh: 这个热身阶段教会学生在开始从自己生成的历史记录中学习之前，如何使用因果注意力和流式键/值缓存进行操作。

blocks.html_en: 2.3. Self-Forcing Distillation

sentences.en: Self-Forcing Distillation
sentences.zh: 自强迫蒸馏

blocks.html_en: Autoregressive models face a familiar problem: during training they may see clean, ground-truth context, while during deployment they must condition on their own imperfect outputs. Small errors can therefore compound over time.

sentences.en: Autoregressive models face a familiar problem: during training they may see clean, ground-truth context, while during deployment they must condition on their own imperfect outputs.
sentences.zh: 自回归模型面临一个熟悉的问题：在训练期间，它们可能会看到干净的、真实的上下文，而在部署期间，它们必须以自己的不完美输出为条件。

sentences.en: Small errors can therefore compound over time.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着时间的推移，小错误可能会变得更加复杂。

blocks.html_en: Cosmos-H-Dreams addresses this mismatch with self-forcing distillation. During training, the student rolls forward using its own generated context. Distribution-matching supervision from the frozen teacher then guides those self-generated rollouts toward realistic surgical video. This prepares the student for the same conditions it will encounter during interactive inference.

sentences.en: Cosmos-H-Dreams addresses this mismatch with self-forcing distillation.
sentences.zh: Cosmos-H-Dreams 通过自强迫蒸馏解决了这种不匹配问题。

sentences.en: During training, the student rolls forward using its own generated context.
sentences.zh: 在训练期间，学生使用自己生成的上下文进行前滚。

sentences.en: Distribution-matching supervision from the frozen teacher then guides those self-generated rollouts toward realistic surgical video.
sentences.zh: 然后，冻结教师的分布匹配监督将引导这些自我生成的转播走向真实的手术视频。

sentences.en: This prepares the student for the same conditions it will encounter during interactive inference.
sentences.zh: 这让学生为交互式推理过程中遇到的相同条件做好准备。

blocks.html_en: The resulting model supports few-step diffusion, with as few as two denoising steps per latent frame, rather than the many-step process used by the full teacher. It combines the teacher's surgical priors with the causal structure needed for streaming.

sentences.en: The resulting model supports few-step diffusion, with as few as two denoising steps per latent frame, rather than the many-step process used by the full teacher.
sentences.zh: 生成的模型支持少步扩散，每个潜在帧只需两个去噪步骤，而不是完整教师使用的多步过程。

sentences.en: It combines the teacher's surgical priors with the causal structure needed for streaming.
sentences.zh: 它将教师的手术先验与流媒体所需的因果结构结合起来。

blocks.html_en: 3. FlashDreams: The Real-Time Inference Engine

sentences.en: FlashDreams: The Real-Time Inference Engine
sentences.zh: FlashDreams：实时推理引擎

blocks.html_en: Model distillation is only part of the real-time story. Cosmos-H-Dreams is served through FlashDreams, an accelerated inference library for autoregressive world and video models.

sentences.en: Model distillation is only part of the real-time story.
sentences.zh: 模型蒸馏只是实时故事的一部分。

sentences.en: Cosmos-H-Dreams is served through FlashDreams, an accelerated inference library for autoregressive world and video models.
sentences.zh: Cosmos-H-Dreams 通过 FlashDreams 提供服务，FlashDreams 是一个用于自回归世界和视频模型的加速推理库。

blocks.html_en: FlashDreams turns the distilled student into a low-latency streaming system through several complementary optimizations, such as streaming KV cache, CUDA Graph capturing, or model compilation.

sentences.en: FlashDreams turns the distilled student into a low-latency streaming system through several complementary optimizations, such as streaming KV cache, CUDA Graph capturing, or model compilation.
sentences.zh: FlashDreams 通过多种互补的优化（例如流式 KV 缓存、CUDA 图形捕获或模型编译）将经过精炼的学生转变为低延迟流式系统。

blocks.html_en: Together, these techniques bring the distilled surgical world model fine-tune from the roughly ten-frames-per-second regime of standard Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator inference to interactive operation (~160 frames per second) on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000.

sentences.en: Together, these techniques bring the distilled surgical world model fine-tune from the roughly ten-frames-per-second regime of standard Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator inference to interactive operation (~160 frames per second) on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000.
sentences.zh: 这些技术结合在一起，将精炼的手术世界模型从标准 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 推理的大约每秒 10 帧的状态微调到单个 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上的交互式操作（约每秒 160 帧）。

blocks.html_en: Cosmos-H-Dreams also provides the human-machine interfaces that turn generation into interaction. A browser client can send keyboard commands and receive generated frames over WebRTC. A Meta Quest client can map tracked controller motion into robot actions and display the synthesized scene through WebXR. The same model can also be connected to a learned surgical policy, with generated observations and predicted actions exchanged inside a closed loop.

blocks.html_en: 5. What Is Next: Toward Closed-Loop Surgical Physical AI

sentences.en: What Is Next: Toward Closed-Loop Surgical Physical AI
sentences.zh: 下一步是什么：迈向闭环外科物理人工智能

blocks.html_en: Cosmos-H-Dreams opens a new frontier for surgical simulation: environments learned from real robot data that are responsive enough to be inhabited.

sentences.en: Cosmos-H-Dreams opens a new frontier for surgical simulation: environments learned from real robot data that are responsive enough to be inhabited.
sentences.zh: Cosmos-H-Dreams 开辟了手术模拟的新领域：从真实的机器人数据中学习的环境，其响应速度足以适应居住。

blocks.html_en: The immediate next step is to evaluate more than visual quality. A useful surgical simulator must respond correctly to actions, preserve instrument and scene structure over long rollouts, and support conclusions that transfer to the physical robot. This motivates a new family of closed-loop benchmarks: tool-tip reach and pose accuracy, gripper-cycle fidelity, idle stability, counterfactual action diversity, long-horizon drift, and agreement between simulated and real policy outcomes.

sentences.en: The immediate next step is to evaluate more than visual quality.
sentences.zh: 下一步不仅仅是评估视觉质量。

sentences.zh: 有用的手术模拟器必须正确响应动作，在长时间部署中保留仪器和场景结构，并支持转移到物理机器人的结论。

sentences.en: This motivates a new family of closed-loop benchmarks: tool-tip reach and pose accuracy, gripper-cycle fidelity, idle stability, counterfactual action diversity, long-horizon drift, and agreement between simulated and real policy outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这激发了一系列新的闭环基准：工具提示范围和姿势准确性、夹具循环保真度、闲置稳定性、反事实动作多样性、长视野漂移以及模拟和实际政策结果之间的一致性。

blocks.html_en: Real-time world models can also become active partners in surgical policy development. They can generate rare failures on demand, provide scalable environments for reinforcement or imitation learning, and enable rapid evaluation of new policies without tying every experiment to scarce robotic hardware.

sentences.en: Real-time world models can also become active partners in surgical policy development.
sentences.zh: 实时世界模型也可以成为外科政策制定的积极合作伙伴。

sentences.en: They can generate rare failures on demand, provide scalable environments for reinforcement or imitation learning, and enable rapid evaluation of new policies without tying every experiment to scarce robotic hardware.
sentences.zh: 它们可以根据需要产生罕见的失败，为强化或模仿学习提供可扩展的环境，并能够快速评估新策略，而无需将每个实验都与稀缺的机器人硬件联系起来。

blocks.html_en: Further ahead, real-time simulation enables a series of downstream applications such as latency-aware telesurgery, where the world model helps maintain a more stable display; or interactive surgical rehearsal, procedure planning, and intraoperative decision support. Cosmos-H-Dreams is a research and development platform, not a diagnostic system, a replacement for intraoperative imaging, or a controller for a physical surgical robot. Yet it provides a foundation for exploring these possibilities safely.

content_html_zh:
返回文章

  • 1. 从手术世界模型到交互式模拟器
  • 2. 实时蒸馏 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 2.1。 外科老师 2.2。 因果热身 2.3。 自强迫蒸馏
  • 3. FlashDreams：实时推理引擎
  • 4. 适应您自己的数据
  • 5. 下一步是什么：迈向闭环外科物理人工智能
  • 6. 今天开始

手术机器人技术正在迅速从远程操作转向功能日益强大的视觉-语言-动作策略。 但评估和训练这些系统仍然很困难。 物理机器人平台的运行成本昂贵，实验重现缓慢，并且故障可能会损坏仪器或生物材料。 传统的模拟器提供了更安全的替代方案，但手术场景的建模非常困难：可变形组织、精细仪器相互作用、镜面、缝合线、针、烟雾和遮挡都很重要。

世界基金会模型提供了一条不同的道路。 他们无需手动创作每个对象和物理交互，而是直接从同步视频和机器人运动学中学习视觉动力学。 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 通过从初始场景和一系列机器人动作生成未来的手术视频来演示这种方法。 它在 Open-H-Embodiment 生态系统中实现了比物理更快的评估和合成数据生成。

今天，我们将介绍下一步：Cosmos-H-Dreams，一种用于手术机器人的实时、动作条件生成模拟器。 Cosmos-H-Dreams 将 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 的功能提炼为因果性、几步学生模型，并通过 NVIDIA 的加速流式推理库 FlashDreams 提供服务。 在单个 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上运行，结果是一个人或学习策略可以在闭环中控制的交互式环境。

1. 从手术世界模型到交互式模拟器

Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 是一个基于 NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 构建的动作条件世界基础模型，并在 Open-H-Embodiment 数据集上进行了后训练。 给定手术背景框架和未来的机器人轨迹，它会生成视频，显示这些动作可能产生的视觉后果。 这使得它对于离线政策评估和合成数据生成非常有用。 可以将记录的或策略生成的轨迹发送到模型，可以生成相应的 rollout，并且可以检查或评分结果，而无需在物理机器人上重复执行运动。

Cosmos-H-Dreams 将模型转移到实时状态。 从 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 学到的多实施例手术先验开始，我们专门设计了达芬奇研究套件 (dVRK) 桌面缝合模型，并将其提炼成一个自回归生成场景的因果学生。 发布的模型接收初始 RGB 帧和机器人运动学的实时流，然后生成下一个帧块，然后继续执行以下操作块。

我们还与 CMR Surgical 和 Cambridge Consultants 合作，将 Cosmos-H-Dreams 与 Versius 外科医生控制器集成，从而实现了 Versius 平台上的实时操作，从而展示了 Cosmos-H-Dreams 的多功能性。

2. 实时蒸馏 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator

关键的挑战是保持有用的手术动力学，同时降低生成成本。 Cosmos-H-Dreams 使用专为长期自回归部署而设计的教师到学生培训流程。

2.1. 外科老师

双向教师从 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator Open-H 检查点开始，它使用统一的 44 维动作表示。 对于已发布的 dVRK 桌面模型，双臂 dVRK 动作内容（包括相对末端执行器平移、旋转和夹具状态）被映射到此通用表示中。

然后，教师在 JHU dVRK 桌面混合物上进行微调，包括成功的演示以及失败和未分配的事件，例如落针、错过投掷和不成功的打结。 这些失败很重要：旨在评估政策的模拟器必须重现不良行为的后果，而不仅仅是理想的演示。

为了提高长期部署期间的稳定性，培训过程逐渐增加教师的时间视野。 我们开始在 12 帧范围内进行训练，并逐渐增加这个数字直到 72 帧。 在每个地平线凹凸处，我们使用预训练的权重初始化预热模型。

2.2. 因果热身

首先预先计算并缓存教师的去噪轨迹。 因果学生从教师处初始化并接受训练以模仿这些缓存的轨迹。 这个热身阶段教会学生在开始从自己生成的历史记录中学习之前，如何使用因果注意力和流式键/值缓存进行操作。

2.3. 自强迫蒸馏

自回归模型面临一个熟悉的问题：在训练期间，它们可能会看到干净的、真实的上下文，而在部署期间，它们必须以自己的不完美输出为条件。 因此，随着时间的推移，小错误可能会变得更加复杂。

Cosmos-H-Dreams 通过自强迫蒸馏解决了这种不匹配问题。 在训练期间，学生使用自己生成的上下文进行前滚。 然后，冻结教师的分布匹配监督将引导这些自我生成的转播走向真实的手术视频。 这让学生为交互式推理过程中遇到的相同条件做好准备。

生成的模型支持少步扩散，每个潜在帧只需两个去噪步骤，而不是完整教师使用的多步过程。 它将教师的手术先验与流媒体所需的因果结构结合起来。

3. FlashDreams：实时推理引擎

模型蒸馏只是实时故事的一部分。 Cosmos-H-Dreams 通过 FlashDreams 提供服务，FlashDreams 是一个用于自回归世界和视频模型的加速推理库。

FlashDreams 通过多种互补的优化（例如流式 KV 缓存、CUDA 图形捕获或模型编译）将经过精炼的学生转变为低延迟流式系统。

这些技术结合在一起，将精炼的手术世界模型从标准 Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator 推理的大约每秒 10 帧的状态微调到单个 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上的交互式操作（约每秒 160 帧）。

Cosmos-H-Dreams 还提供将生成转化为交互的人机界面。 浏览器客户端可以通过 WebRTC 发送键盘命令并接收生成的帧。 Meta Quest 客户端可以将跟踪的控制器运动映射到机器人动作中，并通过 WebXR 显示合成的场景。 同一模型还可以连接到学习的手术策略，并在闭环内交换生成的观察结果和预测动作。

4. 适应您自己的数据

虽然 Cosmos-H-Dreams 包括用于桌面缝合的预训练检查点，但该系统设计为可扩展至您的特定实施例。 为了为您自己的数据集训练实时学生模型，我们在分步指南中提供了教师微调和自我强制蒸馏的完整方法。

5. 下一步是什么：迈向闭环外科物理人工智能

Cosmos-H-Dreams 开辟了手术模拟的新领域：从真实的机器人数据中学习的环境，其响应速度足以适应居住。

下一步不仅仅是评估视觉质量。 有用的手术模拟器必须正确响应动作，在长时间部署中保留仪器和场景结构，并支持转移到物理机器人的结论。 这激发了一系列新的闭环基准：工具提示范围和姿势准确性、夹具循环保真度、闲置稳定性、反事实动作多样性、长视野漂移以及模拟和实际政策结果之间的一致性。

实时世界模型也可以成为外科政策制定的积极合作伙伴。 它们可以根据需要产生罕见的失败，为强化或模仿学习提供可扩展的环境，并能够快速评估新策略，而无需将每个实验都与稀缺的机器人硬件联系起来。

更进一步，实时模拟支持一系列下游应用，例如延迟感知远程手术，其中世界模型有助于保持更稳定的显示；或交互式手术演练、手术规划和术中决策支持。 Cosmos-H-Dreams 是一个研发平台，而不是诊断系统、术中成像的替代品或物理手术机器人的控制器。 然而，它为安全地探索这些可能性提供了基础。

随着模型保真度、时间稳定性和硬件效率的不断提高，实时生成模拟可以帮助在一个共享的物理人工智能环境中连接外科医生教育、合成数据生成、政策培训和政策评估。
